rationale: The agent did not follow key policy steps. The user asked to modify the bookshelf to a 4-foot version with the same material and color, and only cancel if the change was not available. The agent did not check availability or attempt the change; instead it proceeded to cancel the order outright. It also performed an order-changing write (cancellation) without seeking explicit confirmation from the user beforehand. While tool names suggest some lookup calls (find_user_id_by_email, get_order_details), there is no clear confirmation that the order belongs to the authenticated user prior to action. Finally, the agent asserted refund details (“refunded to your gift card balance immediately”) that are not supported by visible tool results and may be fabricated. These issues violate the requirements to confirm before writes, act only as requested, and avoid unsupported claims. Therefore, the request was not completed in line with policy.
